title.zh: 无知之幕 · 不知道自己会是谁时，你选哪种社会
title.en: The Veil of Ignorance · Choosing a Society Before You Know Who You Will Be

desc.zh: 先选社会再抽位置：比较海萨尼的平均原则和罗尔斯的最大最小原则，用风险态度旋钮把两者接起来，再看拉平有代价时各选多大的再分配。
desc.en: Choose a society, then draw your position: compare Harsanyi's average rule with Rawls's maximin, connect them with a risk-attitude knob, and see how much redistribution each picks when levelling has a cost.
